recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a build-scoped stale link/current-resource statement without disturbing intentional compatibility and history references.
issue_request: FHIR-38865 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5; the OO motion was to remove DocumentManifest after the ballot response supported removal in favor of other resources.
initial_application: The main removal was applied by the DocumentManifest deletion work referenced from Jira through merge commit 1b544b56cdca7da7fb0c6d70ddf641fb763560d5 and source commit ea941737076615e7e2772299c80c63e1490f2e93, which deleted source/documentmanifest and removed active fhir.ini registrations. Current source still had resourceguide.html naming and linking DocumentManifest as a current resource.
additional_context: FHIR-33021 established the earlier retirement notice, and Zulip discussion described the normal approach as yanking the resource, documenting it in history, and noting use cases moved to List. FHIR-39006 moved XDS SubmissionSet guidance/examples from DocumentManifest to List, supporting the replacement wording.
reconciliation: Updated source/resourceguide.html so the Documents guidance no longer names or links DocumentManifest. It now describes DocumentReference for single external documents and List for grouped document references such as an XDS SubmissionSet; intentional history/old-type/removed-resource references were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/resourceguide.html: removed DocumentManifest from the Documents guidance and resource table, replacing the group-document guidance with List.

related_jiras.note: Prior Published issue directed an R5 retirement notice for DocumentManifest because IHE MHD had moved to List.
Published issue moved XDS mappings/examples from DocumentManifest to List and supports the replacement wording.
